description: Use for Shopify store questions like "how did the store do last month", "why did our store revenue drop", "what's our store's average order value", "how many orders did the shop take last week", "what's our store's refund rate", or a weekly or monthly trading check on the shop — even when the user never says "performance". Use when the decision is whether store revenue moved and which of orders, order size or returns moved it. Shopify only.
